verdict.rationale: Limitless's developer docs give the pieces of a bring-up path: log in and click "Create API Key", then call documented endpoints to fetch Pendant Lifelogs, with an example repository showing how to use the API. However, no evidence shows a dedicated end-to-end quickstart, and nothing confirms a developer reached a first completed device task from the docs alone. missing for 10: an explicit install-to-first-task quickstart walkthrough, device/pendant pairing setup steps, hands-on or independent confirmation that the docs alone suffice.
